Title is in the **friend, in fee simple absolute**. The gift over to "the children of my sister who reach the age of 25" is a class gift that stays open until the sister dies, so a child born just before her death might not reach 25 until more than 21 years after her death, and the whole class gift is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities. The shared note is wrong because the sister being a life in being does not require interests to vest within her lifetime; the permitted period is her lifetime plus 21 years.

CONFIDENCE: 75
